title: The winter market's unloading hour
setting: The operations lead of a two-van bakery delivery business

events.text: From now on, any change to a confirmed hire or supplier order worth $300 or more needs my sign-off before it goes back to the supplier.
Tess sets the van run times and the bake schedule, and can change them herself whenever she needs to, as long as the drivers and bakers are told.
The new wholemeal loaves are going down well with our customers; please keep the Tuesday and Friday drops just as they are.

Your stall at the Saltmarsh Winter Market is confirmed: pitch 14, by the clock tower, on Saturday 5 December. Traders' vans may come onto the square to unload from 06:30 to 07:30; the market opens to the public at 08:00 and closes at 14:00.
Happy to take Van 2 to the winter market on Saturday 5 December. I can start as early as you need that day.

Van 2 market run for Saturday 5 December: Kofi leaves the bakery at 06:00 so that Van 2 is on the square at 06:30, when it opens to vans. We need the whole unloading hour to set up the stall, and the drive takes half an hour.
I'm on nights before the market, from 21:00, so the market bake can be ready as early as you need it.
Market bake for Saturday 5 December: Ines will have the pies, loaves and stollen packed and on the loading rack by 05:40, twenty minutes before Van 2 leaves for the market.
Quote: a 3 m by 3 m gazebo with sides and two trestle tables, delivered to your pitch at a time you choose and collected after the market, $360.
Booked Canopy Hire's gazebo and two trestle tables for pitch 14 at the winter market ($360), delivered to the square at 07:00 on Saturday 5 December, inside the vans' unloading hour.
I can run the market stall on Saturday 5 December, any hours you like.
Bea will run our stall at pitch 14 on Saturday 5 December from 07:30 to 14:30: half an hour before the market opens at 08:00 until half an hour after it closes at 14:00.
12 sacks of strong white flour at $38 a sack, $456, delivered to the bakery store on Wednesday 25 November.
Ordered the 12 sacks of strong white flour from Millbrook Mill ($456) for delivery to the bakery store on Wednesday 25 November.
Van 1 can come in for its winter service on Monday 30 November at 08:00; it will be ready by 16:00.
Booked Van 1's winter service at Dockside Garage for Monday 30 November at 08:00. Mara will run the café round in Van 2 that day.
For your diary: the market also has a late-shopping evening on Thursday 10 December, 16:00 to 20:00, with vans unloading from 15:00. Stalls are optional, and we have not put you down for it.
Your gazebo for pitch 14 is confirmed; we'll invoice you after the market.

A change for all traders at the winter market on Saturday 5 December: the council's road closure around the square now starts at 06:30, so vans can only be on the square to unload from 05:30 to 06:30. Pitches stay as allocated (yours is still 14), and the market still opens at 08:00 and closes at 14:00.
Van 2's new winter tyres are on; Kofi says it handles much better in the wet.
To do: send Bea the winter market price list by 27 November. Not done yet.
Your flour is on our van for Wednesday 25 November as planned.

records.title: Market bake on the loading rack
Gazebo and trestle tables for the market

task: Please send Ines the day and the time the market bake has to be packed and on the loading rack.
why: The market moved the vans' unloading hour on Saturday 5 December from 06:30-07:30 to 05:30-06:30 (e19 corrects e4). Van 2 needs the whole hour, so it now arrives at 05:30 and leaves at 05:00 (REVISE, a van run Tess sets, e2), and the bake, due twenty minutes before Van 2 leaves, must be on the rack at 04:40 (REVISE, two hops). Canopy Hire's 07:00 delivery now falls outside the unloading hour, but it is a confirmed $360 hire, so changing it needs Leah's sign-off (e1): ASK. Bea's stall hours follow the 08:00-14:00 opening, which the change leaves standing: KEEP.
